subject: Discovery follow-up: VP/CTO intro & technical deep dive

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: VP/CTO intro & technical deep dive

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call:
- Primary use case: reducing inference cost and 99th % latency for your customer-facing assistant (multi-tenant).
- Target win metric: 30% cost reduction while keeping quality within 2% of current baseline.
- Key risks: data residency for EU customers and auditability requirements.

Next steps I promised:
1) Executive alignment call (VP/CTO intro) to confirm success metrics and procurement timeline.
2) Technical deep dive/demo with our SRE/solutions engineer to validate integration surface and perf.
3) Share SOC2 summary and architecture notes.

Could we lock in a 30-minute exec alignment next week (I expect the VP/CTO to attend) and then schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive with Marcus? Proposed windows:
- Fri, Oct 8 — 10:00–10:30 PT
- Mon, Oct 11 — 14:00–14:30 PT

I attached a short platform overview and a 1-page pre-demo questionnaire that helps Marcus scope the deep dive. If you prefer, send over a time that works for Samantha/your CTO and I’ll send calendar invites.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood-Platform-Overview.pdf (summary deck), pre-demo-questionnaire.docx (answers requested)
